body.name: \(\operatorname{SparseSIM\text{-}ID}\)
body.construction: Accept only a tuple certified by \(\mathrm{def{:}certified\text{-}input}\), construct all \(T_{D,y}\), \(F_{D,y}\), and \(K_{\mathcal I}\), and compute \(\operatorname{NF}_{\prec,K_{\mathcal I}}(F_{D,y})\) in canonical order. If every normal form is zero, output the reference arithmetic circuit and real-Nullstellensatz plus saturation identities. Otherwise enumerate reduced rational tables of bit length at most \(B_{\mathrm{cert}}\) in canonical order until one lies in \(\mathcal M_{\mathcal I}^{\circ}\) and has a nonzero failed signature, then output that table and the corresponding DAG pair.
